    • getDataProperty

      @BeanProp("data") public Object getDataProperty()
      Bean-property view of data typed as Object, so the property type matches setData(Object) and the parser accepts a bare JSON number as well as a string.
      Returns:
      The data source, or null if none.

    • setData

      @BeanProp("data") public DataTablesRequest.Column setData(Object v)
      Sets the column's data source.

      DataTables sends data as a string (object source) or a bare JSON number (array source), so this accepts any value and normalizes it to its string form; getData() always returns a string.

      Parameters:
      v - The value (a string or a number).
      Returns:
      This object.
